escena: SCENE (cinematic, Hollywood blockbuster still, epic scale, a vast dark hangar-like studio at night, slight low camera angle): behind her rises a colossal floating MOSAIC wall, as tall as a building, made of hundreds of thin frameless glowing screens of every real digital format — tall vertical 9:16 story screens, square 1:1 and 4:5 feed posts, wide 16:9 video frames, long horizontal web banners — all showing the SAME bold, vivid, art-directed campaign adapted to each format: saturated color-block graphics, a product close-up splashed with paint, a dancer mid-jump; they throw colored light in vivid orange, hot magenta, deep azure-blue (#0375DB), violet and teal (#36C8BF); any tiny text on them is too small and blurred to read, fitted together edge to edge like a giant puzzle that fills the right half of the frame and disappears into the darkness above. She stands in front of it at about 64% of the frame width, framed from the waist up, holding ONE last screen in her raised hand as she slots it into the single empty gap of the mosaic beside her shoulder, and the whole wall lights up from that point. She looks straight into the lens with a quiet, proud half-smile. REALISTIC ADULT PROPORTIONS: camera about two meters away at chest height, 85mm, she does not lean toward the lens. She wears the NAVY EFEONCE SOFTSHELL JACKET over the navy polo, no lanyard, no watch, no rings. Her head stays almost frontal, both eyes and both eyebrows visible, and stays in the middle band of the frame height, never touching the top edge. The LEFT HALF of the frame (from 0% to 50% of the width) is calm, deep dark space with only faint haze: no cards, no screens, no beams, no light and no objects there; nothing crosses the vertical center line. The mosaic is the main light source and paints her face and jacket with its colors; cool rim light from behind. Enormous contrast, punchy, cinematic, no logos of any other brand, no readable text, no letters or numbers anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the dark metal railing of a mezzanine close to the lens, matte black, the lens only a few centimetres behind it, outside every light

texto.muro: the calm, deep dark space on the left 50% of the frame
